hmmm: Molweni is a filtered and annotated derivative of Ubuntu chat; collection, filtering, transcription, and annotation effects cannot be separated from the released text.
The released DP files contain 176 empty speaker fields across train and dev; their upstream cause is unknown, so they remain malformed source evidence rather than inferred identities.
One released MRC dev dialogue has two relation endpoints beyond its 12-EDU sequence; both malformed edge objects remain retained evidence and are not repaired or dropped.
Two released MRC relation graphs disagree with the DP relation graph for an identical ordered EDU sequence; the runner retains the disagreement and does not choose or repair a graph.
Unanswerable MRC questions and plausible spans are positive source annotations, not proof that a discourse reference is formally unresolved under UCNS.
Exact profile observations and graph retention are represented evidence, not formal UCNS geometry, EDCM measurement validity, diagnosis, intention, morality, consciousness, or external truth.

annotation_layers.dp: source-native ordered EDUs plus directed labeled relation objects
annotation_layers.mrc: differently partitioned contexts, ordered EDUs, relation objects, questions, answerability flags, exact answer spans, and plausible spans

information_boundaries.cross_view_policy: match complete ordered EDU objects by digest; compare complete directed relation lists independently; retain ambiguous duplicate matches and disagreements
information_boundaries.profile_input: ordered DP edus only, as exact source-native (speaker, text) tuples
profile_noninputs_retained_by_source: MRC duplicate EDU and relation views
information_boundaries.speaker_identity: nonempty source-native edus[].speaker strings pass unchanged; empty strings remain source evidence and receive a collision-checked dialogue-and-turn ordinal sentinel only at the nonempty UCNS adapter boundary

privacy_and_removal.collection_context: filtered and annotated multiparty dialogues derived by the Molweni authors from the Ubuntu Chat Corpus
privacy_and_removal.committed_outputs: aggregate counts, cryptographic identities, reconciliation, and receipts only; no dialogue, speaker, context, question, or answer text
privacy_and_removal.removal_path: remove the locally held checkout and invalidate or supersede aggregate receipts by repository commit and file SHA-256; no raw corpus object is committed
privacy_and_removal.source_effects: upstream chat collection and Molweni utterance-count, speaker-count, sentence-length, selection, discourse-annotation, and MRC-annotation effects remain inseparable provenance
